text: Giving an F[x]-module structure on a finite-dimensional F-vector space V amounts to choosing:
choices: a linear operator T: V → V, with x acting as T
a polynomial whose roots lie in V
explanation: Once x acts as a linear map T, any polynomial p(x) must act as p(T), and conversely any T defines such an action. Under this dictionary, submodules are T-invariant subspaces, and the structure theorem yields the rational and Jordan canonical forms.
